about: rift monster variants painted with PixelLab over the frames of our own rift looks (rift_variants.py). Raw results are not in git; the sheets are (art_import/rift_variants/).

variants.name: Abyssal Pallid Gazer
variants.description: bone-white tentacled horror with teal tentacles and three cyan eyes

jobs.prompt: turn the violet tentacled eye creature into a pale bone-white deep abyss horror with sickly teal-green tentacles and three glowing cyan eyes; keep the exact pose, size, silhouette and motion of every frame; dark fantasy pixel art, crisp pixels, dark outline, no blur

this is the creature seen from behind: remove the three cyan eyes, paint plain pale bone-white skin with faint grey veins where the eyes were; change nothing else, keep every pixel of the silhouette and the tentacles
